content:
sara-finance: FYI noticed a sudden $8.6k GPU spike yesterday under project `partner-trials-2026` — looks like trial customers spun up long-running jobs. Not tagged to any internal team.
lee-ops: That's the new partner onboarding pipeline, right? We should have labeled those runs with `customer_id` and `trial=true`.
priya-accounts: Which partner is this tied to? We need to invoice or apply promo credits per contract.
sara-finance: Billing export line shows `partner-trials-2026` as the project; the only customer metadata is in onboarding DB, not in cloud tags. I suspect the onboarding script didn't pass labels.
billing-bot: [automated] Billing export available: gs://redwood-billing/exports/2026-04/billing-2026-04.csv.gz
lee-ops: Can we backfill by joining cloud instance names to the onboarding DB? The trial jobs include `trial_run_<partner_shortname>_<id>` in the instance name.
tom-eng: I can run a quick regex map. Quick CLI I used:
```
gsutil cat gs://redwood-billing/exports/2026-04/billing-2026-04.csv.gz | gunzip -c | awk -F, '/GPU/ {print $1,$10,$15}' | grep 'partner-trials-2026'
```
Then join to onboarding table by instance_name.
sara-finance: If we can prove it's partner X, we have two options: (A) invoice them for overage (per contract cap) or (B) apply the agreed promotional credit. Need approvals from accounts.
priya-accounts: Pinged @account-manager (external) via email for direction. Meanwhile, we need a temporary internal allocation to bill center `partner-platform` so our monthly budget isn't skewed.
vendor-ops: Partner-facing tooling also created some GPU workers for late night tests. We should include vendor ops in the mapping; they have additional logs with run metadata.
tom-eng: Ran join, looks like 124 instance-hours, $8,632. Mapped to partners: 72% Partner X, 28% Partner Y based on instance name pattern. Uploaded mapping CSV: gs://redwood-finance/allocations/1932104567-partner-split.csv (access: finance+accounts).
lee-ops: I'll create a temporary cost assignment: set labels `cost_center=partner-platform` and `partner_split=auto` on those instance records in inventory so finance queries reflect it.
sara-finance: Good. For chargeback: @priya-accounts, can you get confirmation from the two partner AEs? Also need legal signoff if we bill beyond promo credits.
priya-accounts: Reached out. AE responded: Partner X accepts paying overage for production runs but thought trials were limited. They requested the run logs and exact timestamps. I'll send mapping CSV and ask for approval to invoice.
billing-bot: [automated] Alert: monthly untagged GPU spend for project `partner-trials-2026` = $8,632 (threshold $1,000)
lee-ops: Ops action items: (1) patch onboarding script to write `--labels=customer_id=$ID,trial=true` on VM create (PR link forthcoming), (2) add CI check to reject unlabeled run submissions.
tom-eng: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/onboarding/pulls/29 — adds labels and validation. I'll add a canary deploy and rollback plan.
sara-finance: Finance will hold a provisional allocation to `partner-platform` for April while accounts confirms partner billing. If partners decline, we can absorb under marketing trial budget but want to avoid that.
vendor-ops: Note: vendor contract mentions 50 free trial GPU-hours per partner per month. We should reconcile that before invoicing.
priya-accounts: Good catch. I'll ask for partner usage vs free allowance. If within allowance, no invoice. If over, request approval to invoice or apply company credit.
sara-finance: Final action list: priya to confirm partner allowance and approval (48h), lee to merge onboarding labeling PR (24h), tom to attach run logs and mapping to the AE email (ASAP). Finance will not finalize chargebacks until partner confirmation.
priya-accounts: Confirmed with partner AE: Partner X used 550 GPU-hours; free allowance is 200 hrs. They asked for itemized invoice for the 350 overage.
sara-finance: Thanks. I'll prepare invoice draft and route to legal for contract alignment. Will post back here when invoice is sent.
lee-ops: After PR merge, I'll run a retroactive tagging script to annotate historical inventory with `customer_id` where we can match. That will help future attributions.
tom-eng: Uploaded logs and summarized per-run costs to the AE email thread.
priya-accounts: AE approved receiving invoice. Please cc billing@partnerx.com and include line items by date.
sara-finance: Invoice drafted and scheduled for send tomorrow AM. Closing notes: need a monitoring alert to detect any project with untagged GPU > $500 in a week. Can we add that?
billing-bot: [automated] Created alert policy: projects/partner-trials-2026/alerts/untagged-gpu-weekly > $500
sara-finance: Thanks all. I'll update this thread once the invoice is out and the funds are applied.
